caption: The drawing depicts a single straw bonnet with a wide, rounded brim. The main body of the bonnet is woven in a pattern, with a natural beige color typical of straw. The edge of the bonnet is adorned with a ruffled blue fabric trim that extends around the entire opening and down the sides. Two long, blue, textured fabric ties hang down from the sides, each with a ruffled appearance, matching the trim around the bonnet. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or light cream color with no additional objects or details, and the corners are slightly darkened. The composition centers the bonnet prominently, displaying its side profile.
title: Shaker Bonnet
